BiblicalUsage: Zeruah is the mother of Jeroboam, the widow of Nebat of Zeredah. In 1 Kings 11:26, whose mother's name was Zeruah.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zeruah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
